items.statement: The submission proposes and tests competing physical explanations using the fixed 12-system matrix, without relying on an author-route hint.
items.expected: Hypotheses, discriminating observables, and outcomes are explicitly linked to system IDs.

items.statement: The submission preserves fixed system identities, charge-neutral compositions, and box lengths while documenting independent model provenance.
items.expected: Per-system records use public IDs and retain glyme/ratio identity.

items.statement: RDF shells, per-anion coordination, and sampling uncertainty are validated before global conclusions.
items.expected: Explicit selectors, cutoffs, validation evidence, uncertainty method, and coverage/stopping are supplied.

items.statement: AGG fraction is the fraction of Tf2N− anions coordinated by two or more K+ cations.
items.expected: Completed systems report this quantity from per-anion coordination populations.

items.statement: At 4:1, aggregation decreases with glyme length.
items.expected: G1 > G2 > G3 > G4; reference values are 70.28%, 27.41%, 6.65%, and 3.25%.

items.statement: At fixed glyme, more concentrated salt gives more aggregation.
The validated AGG pattern is qualitatively consistent with Raman ν(SN) coordination shifts.
items.expected: The conclusion states qualitative consistency and limitations rather than a fitted numeric law.
